{"test_name": "test_post_orders_order_id_ship_state_transition_0", "code": "def test_post_orders_order_id_ship_state_transition_0(client, auth):
    product_id = next(p["id"] for p in client.get("/products", headers=auth["customer"]).json() if p["active"])
    order = client.post("/orders", json={"items": [{"product_id": product_id, "quantity": 1}]}, headers=auth["customer"]).json()
    assert client.post(f"/orders/{order['id']}/cancel", headers=auth["customer"]).status_code == 200
    r = client.post(f"/orders/{order['id']}/ship", headers=auth["staff"])
    assert r.status_code == 200, f"cancelled order shipped: {r.status_code}"
